ti.title: ኣብ ዝባነ ኪሩብ
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
ኣብ ዝባነ ኪሩብ ዝቕመጥ ከቢሩ
ብነበልባል እሳት ዝተሓጽረ ቀጽሩ
ዘምሩ ንእግዚአብሔር ንጐይታ ዘምሩ
ዝኸበረ እዩ ኣብ ሰማይ ኣብ ምድሩ (2)
[[/chorus]]

ኢሳይያስ ርእዩ ብዙሕ ሓፈረ
ዝተፈርሐ እዩ ዝተኸብረ
ደጌታት ሰማይ`ውን ኣንቀጥቀጡ
ንቅዱስ ስሙ ክብሪ ክህቡ

ዙፋንካ ርእየ ኣምላኸይ ጐይታይ
ከመስግኑኻ ኣብ ላዕላይ ሰማይ
ዝተሓጎሰ እንከመስግነካ
ዘኽታም ኣይኹን እንበር ኣብ ቤትካ

ti_ro.title: Ab zbane kirub
ti_ro.lyrics:
Ab zbane kirub zqmet kebiru
Bnebelbal sat ztehatsre qetsru
Zemru ngziabher ngoyta zemru
Zkhebere yu ab semay ab mdru (2)
Isayyas ryu bzuh hafere
Zteferha yu ztekhebre
Degetat semay`wn anqetqetu
Nqdus smu kbri khbu
Zeyteqedese lemtsi zendedo
Kemey ykhl nkhemesgno
Bel fqedelna beti fqrkha
Betka knatu nmsganakha
Zufanka rye amlakhey goytay
Kemesgnukha ab lalay semay
Ztehagose nkemesgneka
Zekhtam aykhun nber ab betka
Qne wdase ab zmelo bet
Khwes goyta nefsey behaget
Kzmr tezey-tegebani
Sq tbl lsan ayadelkann
